text: Yes? Speak to the goddess. Quickly, I'm busy. (I'm not.)
Hi! Came to buy me a drink? No? Dang.

choices.text: Here, food! (feed her the item in your hand)
Tell me about the Axis Order.
I need you to go away.

healed.text: Heal! You can thank me later. (I can only do this once in a while, okay? I'm a goddess, not a fountain.)

text: Mmm! That was great! You really know how to take care of a goddess.
Nom nom... if you have sake, I'll take that too!
Me? Wonderful, of course! I'm just thirsty... and hungry... and I miss heaven.
I'm great! But if a giant toad shows up, I'm hiding behind you. Deal?

sleep.text: Terribly! A goddess needs a real bed, you know. Beds, not floors! Rent a room at the inn when we are tired.

axis.text: The Axis Order adores me! It's the biggest religion in the world... or is it the worst reputation in the world? Nobody knows. But they give me gifts, sometimes.

story.text: Once I purified an entire lake. It got so clean the fish left. They say that's my power... I say it was a victory.

refuse.text: What?! I'm a GODDESS! I'm not going anywhere! You brought me to this world, now deal with it!
